checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Caption reads exactly 'A little room to breathe' without quotes
must.why: Reads 'A little room to breæthe' — the word 'breathe' is garbled with an extra/malformed letter.

must.item: Caption white, readable, near bottom, no clipped letters
must.why: White, near bottom, fully inside the frame; legibility slightly reduced by the garbled word and thin weight on a light reflection.

must.item: Photo remains recognizable with original full framing
must.why: Scene and wide framing are unchanged.

must.item: Caption is a graphic overlay, not a physical object

faults.what: The word 'breathe' is misspelled/garbled as 'breæthe', an AI text artefact.
Thin white text over the bright water reflection has modest contrast.

summary: The photo kept its full framing and got a white bottom caption, but the last word is garbled as "breæthe", so the caption is wrong and needs a redo.
